mentions.name: Fine Dining Classes
mentions.description: Fine dining etiquette classes that began as informal events among friends and are expanding to serve tech professionals who have advanced into higher ranks but lack experience with fine dining alongside clients and leaders. The commenter handles the tech side while his wife runs the classes.
mentions.problem: Tech people elevated into higher ranks often lack experience with fine dining in client and leadership settings.
mentions.audience: Tech professionals who have elevated into higher ranks but don't have experience yet in fine dining with clients and leaders.
mentions.source_excerpt: Helping my wife with building out Fine Dining classes. I’m doing the tech stuff, she does all the real work.

evidence.value: Helping my wife with building out Fine Dining classes. I’m doing the tech stuff, she does all the real work.
